name: Frozen Acid
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid, cold]; Level magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a vial of acid)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration 2 rounds

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

You hurl a fist-sized snowball made from frozen acid.

You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to hit your target. On a successful hit, you deal 1d6 points of cold damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d6). At the beginning of your next turn, the ball of frozen acid melts, dealing 1d4 points of acid damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d4). The target may spend a full-round washing off the acid with at least a gallon of water. If the target does so prior to the beginning of your next turn, the subject takes no acid damage from the melted acid.
